Game Overview

In Fly Fly Fly, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a thrilling aerial adventure in Fly Fly Fly. Navigate through 30 challenging levels, dodging obstacles and collecting berries to restore health. Precision flying is key—avoid the ground and wriggling earthworms or risk losing lives. Can you conquer every level and reveal your true skill?
